queries.sql: SELECT C_Order_ID,DocumentNo,Description,DocStatus,Processed,TotalLines,GrandTotal FROM IDEMPIERE_QUAL.C_Order WHERE Description='BicDB main471 browser acceptance 20261111'

SELECT o.DocumentNo,l.Line,l.QtyOrdered,l.PriceActual,l.LineNetAmt FROM IDEMPIERE_QUAL.C_Order o JOIN IDEMPIERE_QUAL.C_OrderLine l ON o.C_Order_ID=l.C_Order_ID WHERE o.Description='BicDB main471 browser acceptance 20261111' ORDER BY l.Line

SELECT i.C_Invoice_ID,i.DocumentNo,i.DocStatus,i.Processed,i.Posted,i.GrandTotal,i.IsPaid FROM IDEMPIERE_QUAL.C_Invoice i JOIN IDEMPIERE_QUAL.C_Order o ON i.C_Order_ID=o.C_Order_ID WHERE o.Description='BicDB main471 browser acceptance 20261111'

SELECT f.C_AcctSchema_ID,SUM(f.AmtAcctDr),SUM(f.AmtAcctCr) FROM IDEMPIERE_QUAL.Fact_Acct f JOIN IDEMPIERE_QUAL.C_Invoice i ON f.Record_ID=i.C_Invoice_ID JOIN IDEMPIERE_QUAL.C_Order o ON i.C_Order_ID=o.C_Order_ID WHERE f.AD_Table_ID=318 AND o.Description='BicDB main471 browser acceptance 20261111' GROUP BY f.C_AcctSchema_ID ORDER BY f.C_AcctSchema_ID

SELECT p.C_Payment_ID,p.DocumentNo,p.DocStatus,p.Processed,p.Posted,p.PayAmt,p.DiscountAmt,p.IsAllocated FROM IDEMPIERE_QUAL.C_Payment p JOIN IDEMPIERE_QUAL.C_Invoice i ON p.C_Invoice_ID=i.C_Invoice_ID JOIN IDEMPIERE_QUAL.C_Order o ON i.C_Order_ID=o.C_Order_ID WHERE o.Description='BicDB main471 browser acceptance 20261111'

SELECT h.DocStatus,h.Processed,h.Posted,l.Amount,l.DiscountAmt,l.WriteOffAmt,l.OverUnderAmt FROM IDEMPIERE_QUAL.C_AllocationLine l JOIN IDEMPIERE_QUAL.C_AllocationHdr h ON l.C_AllocationHdr_ID=h.C_AllocationHdr_ID JOIN IDEMPIERE_QUAL.C_Invoice i ON l.C_Invoice_ID=i.C_Invoice_ID JOIN IDEMPIERE_QUAL.C_Order o ON i.C_Order_ID=o.C_Order_ID WHERE o.Description='BicDB main471 browser acceptance 20261111'

SELECT f.C_AcctSchema_ID,SUM(f.AmtAcctDr),SUM(f.AmtAcctCr) FROM IDEMPIERE_QUAL.Fact_Acct f JOIN IDEMPIERE_QUAL.C_Payment p ON f.Record_ID=p.C_Payment_ID JOIN IDEMPIERE_QUAL.AD_Table t ON t.AD_Table_ID=f.AD_Table_ID JOIN IDEMPIERE_QUAL.C_Invoice i ON p.C_Invoice_ID=i.C_Invoice_ID JOIN IDEMPIERE_QUAL.C_Order o ON i.C_Order_ID=o.C_Order_ID WHERE t.TableName='C_Payment' AND o.Description='BicDB main471 browser acceptance 20261111' GROUP BY f.C_AcctSchema_ID ORDER BY f.C_AcctSchema_ID
